minecraft_bubble_pop.description: All front and threequarter frames at every tick equal the empty baseline (flat grass + sky). The top row shows only the standard background pattern present on every sheet in this batch: a brown dirt-debris pile at t3, scattered small brown block chunks at t8, clean grass at t20. No distinguishable effect particles anywhere.
possible_roles: subtle ambient effect possibly below capture threshold
minecraft_bubble_pop.notes: Top-row brown chunks are the same background debris event seen on every other sheet, so they are not counted as the effect. Effect itself produced no visible pixels.

minecraft_dolphin.description: Front t3: a loose cluster of small blue specks floating in the sky above the horizon, left of center. Front t8: fewer, higher, fainter blue specks. Threequarter t3 shows a similar small blue speck cluster; t8 only 2-3 specks. Nothing by t20. Top row shows only background debris.
minecraft_dolphin.notes: Only a handful of blue specks; they read as airborne sparkles rather than a body of water.

minecraft_dust_pillar.description: A single tiny dark gray-purple smudge sitting on the grass near frame center at t3 only (front and threequarter). Nothing at t8 or t20 in any angle. Top row shows only background debris.
minecraft_dust_pillar.notes: Only one ambiguous speck separates this from an empty baseline; a pillar-shaped column is not visible at any tick.

minecraft_explosion.description: Front t3 only: a striking white stair-step diagonal streak of square particles ascending from near the ground into the upper sky, like a column of bright blocks climbing rightward. Front t8 and t20 empty. Threequarter row empty at all ticks. Top row shows only background debris.
minecraft_explosion.notes: Visible only in the front camera at t3; the diagonal white staircase is unusual for a radial explosion and may be a directional burst.

minecraft_falling_water.description: Front t3: a tiny cluster of about five small blue specks low on the grass near center. Threequarter t3: a few similar blue specks near the horizon. Top t3: two larger blue square specks and a couple of blue dots beside the debris pile. Nothing by t8 in any angle.
minecraft_falling_water.notes: Only a few blue specks at ground level at t3; no visible column or stream of water.

minecraft_happy_villager.description: Clusters of bright green cross/star-shaped sparkle particles floating in the sky at t3 and t8 (front and threequarter), with two or three green sparkles still visible at front t20. In threequarter the cluster sits right at the horizon line. Top row shows only background debris.
minecraft_happy_villager.notes: Green plus/star twinkles are consistent across two ticks and both horizontal angles; unmistakable.

minecraft_landing_obsidian_tear.description: Small flat purple streaks/dashes lying on the grass, drifting rightward across t3, t8, and t20 in the front and threequarter views. In the top view, short purple dashes appear interleaved with the brown debris chunks at t3 and t8, and two purple dashes remain at t20.
minecraft_landing_obsidian_tear.notes: Purple marks hug the ground plane and persist; direction of drift is consistent across angles.

minecraft_rain.description: Front t3: a loose spray of a dozen-plus small blue droplet specks arcing upward from near the horizon into the sky. Threequarter t3: fewer blue specks above the horizon with a dotted trail down to the grass. Top t3: several blue square specks and dots scattered around the debris pile. Nothing by t8 or t20 anywhere.
minecraft_rain.notes: A one-tick scatter of blue droplets rather than ongoing rainfall; gone immediately after t3.

minecraft_sneeze.description: Front t3: a cluster of cyan/aqua plus-shaped sparkle particles in the upper sky. Front t8: a few higher, sparser cyan sparkles. Threequarter t3: cyan sparkle cluster at the top edge of the frame. Top t3: a clump of cyan plus sparkles sitting on/above the debris pile. Everything gone by t20.
minecraft_sneeze.notes: Same cross-star sprite family as happy_villager but cyan instead of green; dissipates faster.

minecraft_totem_of_undying.description: Chunky square-ish blobs in green and yellow/gold clustered low over the grass at t3 (front and threequarter), fewer at t8, and only two faint green specks left at t20. In the top view, large green and yellow pixel-blobs mix with the brown debris at t3 and t8.
minecraft_totem_of_undying.notes: Big two-tone green/gold mote burst; classic totem palette; heaviest concentration at ground level in the first tick.

minecraft_white_ash.description: Front t3: about six or seven tiny pale peach-white square specks floating in the sky at various heights, plus one on the grass. Front t8: one or two faint specks remain. Threequarter shows a few pale specks at t3 and t8 near the top of frame. Top t3 has a couple of pale specks beside the debris pile. Nothing by t20.
minecraft_white_ash.notes: Specks are few and very pale; easy to miss at full-sheet scale but confirmed in the zoomed crop.

world_event_PARTICLES_AND_SOUND_BRUSH_BL.description: Front t3: a burst of many small gray-brown square debris particles spraying into the sky and littering the grass below, some particles clipped by the top of frame. Threequarter t3: same dark debris burst from a different angle. Only a few faint specks remain at t8; nothing at t20. Top row shows only the standard background debris.
world_event_PARTICLES_AND_SOUND_BRUSH_BL.notes: Debris reads darker/grayer than the brown background pile and is clearly airborne at t3.

world_event_PARTICLES_INSTANT_POTION_SPL.description: Front t3: a dense spray of cyan x-shaped sparkle particles fills the upper-left sky, with scattered cyan specks near the horizon. Threequarter t3: the same dense cyan sparkle burst plus a distinct white splash blob sitting on the grass. Only a stray speck at t8; nothing at t20. Top row shows only background debris.
world_event_PARTICLES_INSTANT_POTION_SPL.notes: The white splat on the ground at threequarter t3 plus the dense cyan sparkle cloud make a clear splash-impact picture.

world_event_PARTICLES_TRIAL_SPAWNER_DETE.description: Front t3 only: several small orange vertical ember rectangles descending from the top edge of the frame, partially cut off by the label bar. Nothing in any other cell; top row shows only background debris.
world_event_PARTICLES_TRIAL_SPAWNER_DETE.notes: Effect is emitted high above the visible frame; only the lower edge of an ember fall is captured, so the full shape is unknown.

superheroes_blue_flame.description: A persistent cluster of deep-blue vertical flame-tongue sprites hovering in the sky, present at t3, t8, and t20 in both front and threequarter views, drifting slightly rightward over time. The cluster reads as several licking flame shapes packed together. Top row shows only background debris.
superheroes_blue_flame.notes: Unusually persistent compared to the one-burst effects; flame tongue silhouettes are readable at sheet scale.

superheroes_homelander_clap_dust.description: Front t3: a large radial burst of many tiny dark gray-black debris specks expanding across the upper sky in a roughly circular pattern, with a faint dust smudge near the horizon beneath it. Threequarter t3: a smaller dark debris burst at the frame edge. Only a couple of faint gray wisps at t8; nothing at t20. Top row shows only background debris.
superheroes_homelander_clap_dust.notes: The radial expansion pattern reads as a shockwave clap; very different signature from the falling debris background.

superheroes_homelander_sun_ember.description: Every front and threequarter cell at all ticks is the empty baseline. The top row shows only the standard background debris pile pattern (pile t3, scattered chunks t8, clean t20) shared by all sheets. No effect pixels visible anywhere.
possible_roles: effect possibly off-frame or below capture threshold
superheroes_homelander_sun_ember.notes: Zero distinguishable effect particles; the orange glow seen in the sibling sparks shot is absent here.

superheroes_nightfall.description: Clusters of cyan/turquoise cross-shaped sparkle particles drifting steadily rightward across the sky from t3 to t20 in both front and threequarter views, shrinking to a few sparkles by t20 at the right frame edge. Top t20 additionally shows a large translucent cyan T-shaped glow patch lying on the ground.
superheroes_nightfall.notes: The large cyan T-shaped glow on the ground at top t20 is unusual — reads as a big soft light quad seen from above.

superheroes_sparks.description: A cluster of chunky red square-block particles floating in the sky at t3 and t8 (front and threequarter), shifting orange by t20 near the right frame edge. Top t20 shows a large translucent orange-gold glow wash covering much of the ground on the right side.

scale_impression: big ember blocks plus area glow
texture_quality: hard square sprites and soft glow

superheroes_sparks.notes: Red-to-orange shift over time plus the huge ground glow at t20 suggest an expanding heat/fire effect rather than simple sparkles.

vfxlab_sparkle_sphere.description: A dense spherical cloud of light-blue/cyan sparkle specks floating high in the sky, present at all three ticks in front and threequarter views. The sphere expands and drifts rightward from t3 to t20, becoming larger and more diffuse, with its lower edge reaching toward the horizon by t20. Top row shows only background debris.
vfxlab_sparkle_sphere.notes: Genuinely spherical formation, not a flat spray — consistent volume readable from both horizontal angles.
